## Product Conviction Charter Gate (Required)

Reference: `docs/PRODUCT_CONVICTION_CHARTER.md`

### 1) Christ-Centered Intent
- [ ] This change exalts Christ and does not elevate platform ego.

### 2) Scripture Authority
- [ ] This change keeps Scripture central and does not position AI as spiritual authority.

### 3) Discipleship Outcome
- [ ] This change clearly supports prayer, worship, scripture rhythm, or faithful obedience.

### 4) Emotional Safety + Tone
- [ ] This change avoids shame, pressure, urgency/FOMO, and comparison language.
- [ ] UX remains calm, sacred, and emotionally safe.

### 5) Formation Over Gamification
- [ ] This change avoids vanity metrics, addictive loops, leaderboards, and performative spirituality.

### 6) Community Humility
- [ ] Any sharing/accountability defaults are private, intentional, and non-comparative.

### 7) Ministry Integrity
- [ ] Core spiritual essentials remain free; paid value is depth/continuity, not spiritual access.

## Reviewer Stop-Ship Rule

- [ ] If any charter gate above is not true, this PR is blocked until redesigned.
